materials_exhausted.note: Local XML/PDF/PMC package/DOCX/linked APD6 rows were sufficient for obtainable-only repair; full point-by-point graph values were not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: APD6 AP06421/AP06422 literature and peptide rows are source_verified. AP06420 sequence identity is exact, but its activity annotation is kept as source_conflict because primary CFU results are target-specific and not equivalent to the compressed APD6 activity scope.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Primary XML/PDF prose and Figure 4/7 locators support 21 CFU/hemolysis rows with endpoint, raw value or qualitative outcome, unit, target, strain, concentration, assay conditions, and source locator.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: SYTOX Green and TEM/SEM remain direct membrane-disruption evidence; CD/SDS/LPS evidence remains supporting biophysical context rather than overclaimed direct killing mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.supplementary_material: DataSheet1.docx and local supplementary HTML/bin landing assets were checked; they provide antibiotic susceptibility/prediction and alignment context, not additional peptide activity/toxicity rows.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CdPMAP-23/AP06420 sequence is source-verified, but APD6 activity text is broader/narrower than the primary source across E. coli ATCC, E. coli MDR, S. aureus, and K. pneumoniae.
Figures 4 and 7 contain full concentration curves; final rows include values stated in source prose and qualitative figure-supported outcomes, not invented point extraction.
DataSheet1.docx supports strain susceptibility and prediction context but does not add peptide CFU/hemolysis rows.
